summary.intent: Review codebase concerns, plan remediation phases, and kick off the GSD manager to discuss and plan those phases in parallel.

workflow: GSD manager can dispatch plan/execute as background agents while discuss runs inline, enabling parallel phase progress from one terminal
STATE.md todo counts can become stale across sessions — always verify actual file count before incrementing
markdownlintignore alone is insufficient when lint-staged passes explicit file paths to markdownlint — the glob exclusion must also live in lint-staged config in package.json
When linter keeps re-escaping a character (like * in 'console.*'), changing the prose to avoid the character entirely is faster than fighting the linter config
gsd-tools.cjs init manager parses ROADMAP.md phase descriptions and will break on markdown escape sequences like \* — prose must use linter-safe wording
Pino/browser ruled out for ZK apps because redaction doesn't work in browser mode and its Sentry transport is Node.js only — both the privacy and integration benefits are lost
Grafana Faro offers 50k sessions/month free vs Sentry's 5k errors/month, and integrates natively with existing Grafana Cloud stack
